backup_password_help: Leave this empty for a portable backup. Anyone with that file can restore it; set a password to encrypt it.
import_password_help: Enter the backup password when one was set. Leave it empty for a default portable backup.
name: Backup name
compatibility_passed: Backup format and schema migration path are supported.
incompatible: This backup cannot be restored to the current system
preflight_passed: Integrity, versions, keys, capacity, and runtime state are compatible.
danger_notice: Recovery enters maintenance mode, pauses writes, and replaces current system data. Enter your password and the complete backup name to confirm.
recovery_started: Recovery was handed to the offline recovery workflow
operation_failed: Operation failed. Refresh and try again.
selection_help: Choose at least one STRUCTURE or DATA entry. STRUCTURE contains configuration records. DATA includes all corresponding persistent records, including logs and execution trajectories.
catalog_failed: Unable to load backup settings. Close and reopen to retry.
estimate_help: Estimates cover selected records before compression. File bytes and archive overhead are additional; the compressed file size varies.
plugin_packages_excluded: Plugin packages are not included. Necessary plugin identity records are retained.
selective_counts: {{tables}} tables and {{rows}} records will be imported.
confirm_missing_plugins: I understand these plugins are missing and confirm importing all records.
selective_restore_notice: Records are inserted or updated using their original primary keys. Target-only records are preserved. No tables are created, replaced, or cleared. Enter your password and the complete backup name to confirm.
restart_required: Restart the server after recovery to load restored settings and plugin registrations.
